annual_basis_note: FX 5.0727 BRL/USD (BCB PTAX 2026-07-15). The state publishes semester/press figures rather than an open per-crossing annual series; the 11M pax + 10M vehicles/yr figure is the government's own system-wide annual basis for the 14 PPP crossings, and H1-2024's 9.65M users covers the 8 litoral crossings only. Santos–Guarujá daily splits (7.6k ped / 7.7k cyclists / 21k vehicles) are crossing-specific; the 20k ped / 11k cyclists / 26k vehicles daily figures are system-wide.
